Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 66

“There is no understanding for the undisciplined, and no contemplation for the undisciplined. For one without contemplation there is no peace, and where is happiness without peace?”

A cascade of dependencies stated in the negative, ending in a rhetorical question. Krishna shows Arjuna that the happiness he wants sits at the far end of a chain he has not begun.
